Opp Rank: mean weekly rank of opponents faced (1 = always faced the top scorer). Lower = harder schedule.  |  Exp W: sum of the fraction of the 7-team field your score beat each round, i.e. what your scores deserved.  |  W Luck = actual wins − expected wins. Positive = lucky (won more than scores warranted). Negative = unlucky.  |  🍀 W: wins where your score was below the round average. 💔 L: losses where your score was above the round average.  |  Avg Score Rank: mean weekly rank (1-8) of your own score within the full field, a schedule-independent measure of raw scoring strength.  |  Luck (Season Performance) = actual rank − avg simulated rank. Negative = lucky fixture draw.
Monte Carlo Schedule Simulation

20,000 randomised, valid round-robin schedules, each one respecting the real league's actual structure (every coach plays every other coach once every 7 rounds, on a repeating cycle), only which cycle gets drawn is randomised. Every coach's own real weekly score is judged against whichever real opponent that trial's schedule assigns them. Rather than list every trial, each bar below shows the full distribution of finishing positions a coach landed on across all 20,000 runs: click a segment to see one concrete example schedule that produced that rank.
